Vets RISE Program - SkillBridge Training Outline

Course Participant: Jordan A. Maxwell
Training Outline Title: Project Management & Continuous Improvement Track
Duration: 12 weeks
Location: Remote (instructor-led online)
Hours: 480

Week 1 (Oct 6 - Oct 10): Agile Foundations (40 hours)
Objective: Build a working vocabulary of Agile roles, events, and artifacts.
Day 1: Course orientation; Agile mindset overview; History of Scrum
Day 2: Mastering Trello; Boards, lists, and cards; Workflow automation basics
Day 3: Scrum roles deep dive; Sprint ceremonies overview
Day 4: User stories and backlog grooming; Estimation with story points
Day 5: Team simulation lab; Retrospective practice

Week 2 (Oct 13 - Oct 17): Data & Reporting Tools (40 hours)
Objective: Produce basic dashboards and reports for project tracking.
Day 1: MS Power BI; Connecting data sources
Day 2: Data modeling fundamentals; DAX basics
Day 3: Building dashboards in MS Power BI; Visualization best practices
Day 4: MS Excel pivot tables; Conditional formatting for status reports
Day 5: Reporting lab; Present a project dashboard

Week 3 (Oct 20 - Oct 24): Green Belt Foundations (40 hours)
Objective: Apply core Lean Six Sigma tools to a sample process problem.
Day 1: Green Belt Foundations; DMAIC overview
Day 2: Process mapping; SIPOC diagrams
Day 3: Root cause analysis; Fishbone diagrams; 5 Whys
Day 4: Control charts introduction; Basic statistics refresher
Day 5: Capstone kickoff; Project charter drafting
